text:
HOOK  fanxp-seed-hook-cricket-schedule  "Cricket Schedule"
  status: published  ·  version 8  ·  updated 2026-10-14T02:58:12.898Z
  Match schedule, shaped for the renderer. Pick the listing mode with the is_live / is_recent / is_upcoming inputs.

INPUT
  series_ids   string  optional  — Series id(s), comma separated.
  team_ids     string  optional  — Team id(s), comma separated.
  client_id    string  optional  — Upstream client id.
  is_live      string  optional  — Include live matches. Default "true".
  is_recent    string  optional  — Include results. Default "true".
  is_upcoming  string  optional  — Include upcoming fixtures. Default "true".
  page         string  optional  — Page number (page_number). Keys the output map. Default 1.
  polling      string  optional  — Pass "true" to poll live. Forces is_live to true and adds meta.polling. Absent by default.
  page_size    string  optional  — Matches per page; the full list is trimmed to this. Default 10.

STEPS  (topological order — steps at the same level run in parallel)
  n4  constant
      depends on: —
      static value:
        {
          "lang": "en",
          "is_live": "true",
          "sorting": "asc",
          "team_ids": "2034,2042",
          "timezone": "0000",
          "client_id": "f79f72dd69f3",
          "is_recent": "true",
          "page_size": "10",
          "series_ids": "15397,15399",
          "is_upcoming": "true",
          "page_number": "1",
          "polling_interval": "10"
        }

  n3  transformer
      depends on: n4
      mid-DAG transformer
      transform: whole-mode
        (
          /* Defaults come from the constant node upstream (steps.n4), so they can be
             edited on the canvas. Used when the caller passes nothing. */
          $defaults := steps.n4.response;
        
          $given := function($v) {( $exists($v) and $v != "" ? $string($v) : undefined )};
        
          /* Explicit input first, then the constant. */
          $or := function($input, $constant) {(
            $exists($given($input)) ? $given($input) : $constant
          )};
        
          /* polling=true is opt-in (absent by default). A polling call is always for
             live data, so it forces is_live on. */
          $polling := $string(input.polling) = "true";
        
          {
            "series_ids": $or(input.series_ids, $given($defaults.series_ids)),
            "team_ids": $or(input.team_ids, $given($defaults.team_ids)),
            "client_id": $or(input.client_id, $given($defaults.client_id)),
            "timezone": $or(input.timezone, $defaults.timezone),
            "lang": $or(input.lang, $defaults.lang),
            "is_live": $polling ? "true" : $or(input.is_live, $defaults.is_live),
            "polling": $polling,
            "is_recent": $or(input.is_recent, $defaults.is_recent),
            "is_upcoming": $or(input.is_upcoming, $defaults.is_upcoming),
            "sorting": $or(input.sorting, $defaults.sorting),
            /* Not sent upstream (pagination is off): the shaping step slices with these. */
            "page_number": $or($or(input.page_number, input.page), $defaults.page_number),
            "page_size": $or(input.page_size, $defaults.page_size),
            "id": input.template.template_id
          }
        )

  n1  apiCall
      depends on: n3
      api: "Cricket Schedule" (fanxp-seed-api-cricket-schedule)
      GET /schedule
      provider: "SI Cricket APIs" — base https://sb.dev-fanxp.sportz.io/cricket/v1
      placeholders: {{input.series_ids}}, {{input.team_ids}}, {{input.client_id}}, {{input.timezone}}, {{input.lang}}, {{input.is_live}}, {{input.is_recent}}, {{input.is_upcoming}}, {{input.sorting}}
      overrides: series_ids={{steps.n3.response.series_ids}}, team_ids={{steps.n3.response.team_ids}}, client_id={{steps.n3.response.client_id}}, timezone={{steps.n3.response.timezone}}, lang={{steps.n3.response.lang}}, is_live={{steps.n3.response.is_live}}, is_recent={{steps.n3.response.is_recent}}, is_upcoming={{steps.n3.response.is_upcoming}}, sorting={{steps.n3.response.sorting}}

  n2  transformer
      depends on: n1, n4
      mid-DAG transformer
      transform: whole-mode
        (
          $src := steps.n1.response;
          $ver := input.image_version ? input.image_version : "1.02";
          $teamLogo := function($id) {(
            "/static-assets/images/teams/" & $string($id) & ".png?v=" & $ver & "&w=50&h=50"
          )};
          $p := steps.n3.response;
          /* Polling is opt-in via input.polling (resolved in the params step). The
             interval comes from the constant node. There is no polling url. */
          $polling := $p.polling = true;
          $pollInterval := steps.n4.response.polling_interval ? $number(steps.n4.response.polling_interval) : 10;
          /* Page number and size come from the params step (input, else constant).
             The API is called with pagination off, so the full list is trimmed here. */
          $page := $p.page_number ? $string($p.page_number) : "1";
          $size := $number($p.page_size);
        
          /* Full list from the API, then the slice for the requested page.
             Page 1 keeps the first $size items, page 2 the next $size, and so on. */
          $allMatches := $src.data.matches;
          $total := $count($allMatches);
          $pageNum := $number($page) > 0 ? $number($page) : 1;
          $start := $exists($size) and $size > 0 ? ($pageNum - 1) * $size : 0;
          $matches := $exists($size) and $size > 0
            ? $filter($allMatches, function($v, $i) { $i >= $start and $i < $start + $size })
            : $allMatches;
          $perPage := $exists($size) and $size > 0 ? $size : $total;
          $totalPages := $perPage > 0 ? $ceil($total / $perPage) : 1;
        
          /* Upstream sends start_date as "M/D/YYYYTHH:mm:ss+00:00". Rewrite the date
             part to ISO "YYYY-MM-DD"; values that are already ISO pass through. */
          $isoDate := function($s) {(
            $exists($s) and $contains($s, "/") ? (
              $d := $split($substringBefore($s, "T"), "/");
              $pad := function($n) { $length($n) < 2 ? "0" & $n : $n };
              $d[2] & "-" & $pad($d[0]) & "-" & $pad($d[1]) & $substring($s, $length($substringBefore($s, "T")))
            ) : $s
          )};
        
          /* Upstream sends start_date as "M/D/YYYYTHH:mm:ss+00:00". Rewrite the date
             part to ISO "YYYY-MM-DD"; values that are already ISO pass through. */
          $isoDate := function($s) {(
            $exists($s) and $contains($s, "/") ? (
              $date := $substringBefore($s, "T");
              $d := $split($date, "/");
              $pad := function($n) { $length($n) < 2 ? "0" & $n : $n };
              $d[2] & "-" & $pad($d[0]) & "-" & $pad($d[1]) & $substring($s, $length($date))
            ) : $s
          )};
        
          /* One participant. $id is passed as a variable so predicates like
             scores[team_id = $id] compare against the team, not a missing field
             on the score/award object. */
          $participant := function($m, $id, $name, $short) {(
            $inn := $m.scores[team_id = $id];
            $value := $join($inn.(team_runs & "/" & team_wickets & " (" & team_overs & ")"), " & ");
            {
              "first_up": $string($m.scores[0].team_id = $id),
              "highlight": $m.winning_team_id = $id ? $m.winning_margin : "",
              "id": $id,
              "innings": [ $inn.{
                "score": team_runs & "/" & team_wickets,
                "overs": "" & team_overs & ""
              } ],
              "logo": $teamLogo($id),
              "name": $name,
              "name_eng": $name,
              "now": $m.current_batting_team_id = $id,
              "short_name": $short,
              "short_name_eng": $short,
              "players_involved": [ $m.award[team_id = $number($id)].player_name ],
              "value": $exists($value) ? $value : ""
            }
          )};
        
          {
            "data": {
              ($page): [ $matches.(
                $m := $;
                {
                  "match_id": match_id,
                  "championship_id": championship_id,
                  "championship_name": championship_name,
                  "comp_type_id": comp_type_id,
                  "end_date": end_match_date_ist,
                  "event_coverage_level": coverage_level,
                  "event_coverage_level_id": coverage_level_id,
                  "event_day": $string($split(match_date_ist, "/")[1]),
                  "event_duration_left": "",
                  "event_format": match_type,
                  "event_group": group,
                  "event_interval": "",
                  "event_is_daynight": $string(day_night),
                  "event_is_linkable": "",
                  "event_name": match_number,
                  "event_priority": priority,
                  "event_session": "",
                  "event_stage": stage,
                  "event_state": live = true ? "L" : recent = true ? "R" : upcoming = true ? "U" : "",
                  "event_status": match_display_status,
                  "event_status_id": match_status_id,
                  "event_sub_status": match_sub_status,
                  "event_this_over": current_innings,
                  "game_id": "",
                  "has_standings": $string(has_standings),
                  "league_code": league,
                  "league_id": league_id,
                  "parent_series_id": parent_id,
                  "parent_series_name": parent_name,
                  "participants": [
                    $participant($m, teama_id, teama_display_name, teama_short_display_name),
                    $participant($m, teamb_id, teamb_display_name, teamb_short_display_name)
                  ],
                  "result_code": "",
                  "result_sub_code": "",
                  "series_end_date": series_end_date_ist,
                  "series_id": series_id,
                  "series_name": series_name,
                  "series_start_date": series_start_date_ist,
                  "sport": "",
                  "start_date": $isoDate(start_date),
                  "tour_id": tour_id,
                  "tour_name": tour_name,
                  "venue_gmt_offset": gmt_offset,
                  "venue_id": venue_id,
                  "venue_name": venue,
                  "winning_margin": winning_margin,
                  "short_event_status": match_status,
                  "event_thisover": current_innings,
                  "event_livecoverage": $string(live_coverage),
                  "matchcenter_url": "/matches/" & $lowercase($replace(teama_short_display_name, " ", "-")) & "-vs-" & $lowercase($replace(teamb_short_display_name, " ", "-")) & "-" & $string(match_file),
                  "highlight_url": "",
                  "display_status": match_display_status
                }
              ) ]
            },
            "meta": $merge([
              $polling ? { "polling": { "interval": $pollInterval } } : {},
              { "templateId": $p.id },
              {
                "pagination": {
                  "total": $total,
                  "count": $count($matches),
                  "per_page": $perPage,
                  "current_page": $pageNum,
                  "offset": $start,
                  "limit": $perPage,
                  "total_pages": $totalPages,
                  "max_pages": $totalPages
                }
              }
            ])
          }
        )
      ** this step's result IS the hook's output (bypasses Hook.transform) **

OUTPUT
  the transformer step "n2" produces the output directly;
  the hook-level transform below is NOT applied.
  transform: whole-mode passthrough ($) — the raw run context is the output

REFERENCE PATHS  (everything a template or the transform may resolve — anything else is a dead ref)
  input
    input.series_ids
    input.team_ids
    input.client_id
    input.is_live
    input.is_recent
    input.is_upcoming
    input.page
    input.polling
    input.page_size
  steps
    steps.n4.response  — constant
    steps.n3.response  — transformer
    steps.n1.response  — apiCall
    steps.n2.response  — transformer
  env  — usable inside API templates
    env.base_url
  cred — usable inside API templates; values never leave the backend
    cred.test

---
To see real values rather than the declared shape, run the hook: cast_run_hook with { hookId: "fanxp-seed-hook-cricket-schedule" }. That calls live partner APIs.
